listing.summary: A native port of Konami's Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1989 arcade), built on the verified decompilation tmntarcade-decomp: TMNT Arcade, the arcade game 1:1, and Splinter Way, made for home. Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, Nintendo Switch and Anbernic. Bring your own ROM set.
